description: This file defines the AjaxPageableResponse class, which extends AjaxResponse. It represents a paginated AJAX response containing data and pagination metadata such as start row, end row, total rows, and the data set itself in JSON format.

classes.name: AjaxPageableResponse
classes.description: A Java class that models a paginated response for AJAX calls, including pagination details and data payload.

methods.name: getStartRow
methods.description: Returns the starting row index of the current page.

methods.name: setStartRow
methods.description: Sets the starting row index for the current page.

methods.name: getEndRow
methods.description: Returns the ending row index of the current page.

methods.name: setEndRow
methods.description: Sets the ending row index for the current page.

methods.name: getTotalRow
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows available.

methods.name: setTotalRow
methods.description: Sets the total number of rows available.

methods.name: getPageInfo
methods.description: Generates a JSON snippet with pagination info including startRow, endRow, and totalRows.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire response object including data and pagination info into a JSON string.
